title: website parity build part (M5-T206) (unmounted, parallel to M5-T173): the web-side exact-section law-link primitive — zr-section-urls.ts (ZR_SECTION_URLS section-page->URL map + zrSectionPageNumber + sectionUrl) and ZrSectionLinks.tsx mirror services/api law_links.py section_url/_section_index and sources.py zr_section_page_number, so every ZR citation resolves to its exact captured section (never the bare host) and a citation with no snapshot shows plain text; a Python parity test writes the golden the web test reads; no mounting (M5-T174 mounts it)
objective: Build the unmounted web-side exact-section law-link primitive that mirrors services/api/app/drawings/report/law_links.py + sources.py, with NO change to the Results flow (M5-T174 mounts it). (1) apps/web/src/lib/architect/zr-section-urls.ts: ZR_SECTION_URLS = the committed section-page->URL map (one entry per captured section page, each URL re-validated through officialZoningTextUrl so a bad or host-only URL is dropped, never the homepage); zrSectionPageNumber(cited) = TS port of sources.zr_section_page_number (strip a leading 'ZR', then match /^\d{1,3}-\d{1,4}/, drop any sub-paragraph, no number -> ''); sectionUrl(cited) = ZR_SECTION_URLS[zrSectionPageNumber(cited)] ?? null. (2) apps/web/src/components/architect/ZrSectionLinks.tsx: a presentational component that, given a list of cited section labels, renders each resolvable one as an anchor (href = its exact section URL, target _blank, rel noopener noreferrer, visible text = the cited label verbatim with its sub-paragraph) and each unresolvable one as plain text; invents nothing for a missing/blank citation. (3) services/api/tests/drawings/report/test_web_parity_links.py: under UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 writes apps/web/src/test-support/report-parity-law-links.json FROM law_links._section_index()/section_url + sources.zr_section_page_number (never by hand) and asserts the golden equals the freshly computed values; the pattern of services/api/tests/drawings/kit/test_web_parity_area_zones.py. (4) apps/web/src/lib/architect/__tests__/zr-section-urls.test.ts + apps/web/src/components/architect/__tests__/zr-section-links.test.tsx: read the SAME golden and assert ZR_SECTION_URLS, zrSectionPageNumber and sectionUrl reproduce every golden entry and every citation/forbidden case, and that ZrSectionLinks renders a link vs plain text accordingly. Editing one golden number reddens both surfaces.
business_reason: The website currently links a law citation only when the data carries a per-citation URL (CalculationEvidence.tsx:144); the appendix/page-8 bare citations the PDF links (ZR 23-362, ZR 12-10, ZR 23-52(b)) show as plain text on the website. This part delivers the missing web resolver + parity guard (D-094 R027/R246) so M5-T174 can show the same exact-section links the PDF shows.

acceptance_scenarios.given: citations in the forms the report carries
acceptance_scenarios.then: it equals sources.zr_section_page_number for a pinned case table: 'ZR 23-52(b)'->'23-52', '12-10'->'12-10', 'ZR 23-344(c)(3)'->'23-344', 'ZR 23-362'->'23-362'; a value with no leading <n>-<n> (null, 123, '', 'Appendix A', 'New York City Zoning Resolution (official text)')->''; the sub-paragraph is dropped for the page but kept in the visible label

it returns the exact official section URL equal to law_links.section_url and the golden: '23-362'->'https://zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov/article-ii/chapter-3/23-362', '12-10'->'https://zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov/article-i/chapter-2/12-10', 'ZR 23-52(b)'->'https://zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov/article-ii/chapter-3/23-52'; never a bare host link

acceptance_scenarios.given: a citation with no qualifying snapshot (e.g. 'ZR 11-25', whose snapshot request_url is None at b561450e)
acceptance_scenarios.when: sectionUrl runs and ZrSectionLinks renders it
acceptance_scenarios.then: sectionUrl returns null and the component shows the cited label as plain text (no anchor, never the homepage) — matching the PDF, which prints 11-25 as plain text

its section_index deep-equals law_links._section_index() (181 distinct section pages at b561450e) and its citation/forbidden case tables equal section_url/zr_section_page_number output; UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 regenerates it from the server code; the web zr-section-urls.test.ts reads the SAME golden and asserts ZR_SECTION_URLS === golden.section_index and each case; any hand edit reddens both

every value passes officialZoningTextUrl (https, host zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov, article/chapter[/section] path, optional valid anchor, no query/credentials/port); a URL that fails is dropped (its page absent, sectionUrl->null), never coerced to the host homepage; a probe value of the bare host returns null

acceptance_scenarios.given: a list of cited section labels (resolvable, unresolvable, and a blank/missing one)
acceptance_scenarios.then: each resolvable label is an anchor with href = its exact section URL, target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer', text = the label verbatim; each unresolvable label is plain text; a blank/missing citation renders nothing (nothing invented)

only allowed_paths; no services/api/app or packages/contracts edit; source-links.ts, AreaAllocation.tsx, report-parity-area-zones.json, the Results-flow components and all apps/web/e2e specs untouched; the _zr_snapshots set byte-unchanged; the component is NOT mounted in any Results-flow file (M5-T174 mounts it); no internal/development language in any web-authored string

risks: RISK 1 (golden source): ZR_SECTION_URLS and the golden are derived from services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1 (181 distinct section pages at b561450e). This part does NOT edit snapshots; if a later task changes the capture set, the Python parity test fails closed and both the golden and zr-section-urls.ts must be regenerated (UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 writes the golden; the builder re-emits the TS map to match). Correctness of the captures is the reference cases/snapshots, not this part.

RISK 2 (cross-language regex): the TS zrSectionPageNumber must match Python re.match semantics (anchored at start, NOT end) — use /^\d{1,3}-\d{1,4}/ and strip a leading 'ZR' case-insensitively before matching; the pinned case table in S1 (shared with the Python side via the golden) guards it.

RISK 3 (production independence): production code must read ZR_SECTION_URLS from zr-section-urls.ts, never import from apps/web/src/test-support (test-only); the golden only guards the committed map. The part is unmounted — no visible change until M5-T174.

RISK 4 (stale ledger status): the primary-checkout project-control state is stale (state.json current_milestone=M4, last_checkpoint D-063; the live work is wave-29). The forbidden list was built from the concurrent wave-29 set, not the stale per-file flags; M4-T005 nominally holds apps/web/src/test-support/** and M5-T125 apps/web/src/lib/contract.ts but both are long accepted — the accepted sibling M5-T202 already placed a golden under apps/web/src/test-support, so the pattern is established. The orchestrator should re-confirm the live holds at the contract seam.
